content:
Looking for new iPhone and iPad games to play? The App Store has plenty of games with no ads and no in-app purchases.

Apple Arcade is a subscription option that works well for the whole family, but it's not the only choice. If you already subscribe to Netflix, you're actually already paying to play a ton of great iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription already includes a huge library of iPhone and iPad games.

Every Netflix subscription plan now includes a large selection of mobile and TV games.

That includes the cheapest plan, "Standard with ads," at $8.99 per month.

No matter which Netflix plan you've chosen, you get access to these mobile and TV games — no ads, no in-app purchases, and no extra charge.

For TV games, Netflix offers a dedicated app for iPhone and iPad called Netflix Game Controller.

This app can turn your phone or tablet into an input device that connects to games on the supported Netflix smart TV app. If you want to step up your mobile gaming experience, a proper iPhone-dedicated controller is your best bet.

Netflix also has another iPhone and iPad app aimed at kids, called Netflix Playground, which offers a variety of mini-games. On top of that there are Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription needed) and Netflix Stories.

Beyond these games, Netflix supports more than 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download any of them from the App Store, then sign in with your Netflix email and password to play.
